name: memova
description: Run Memova workflows and explicitly import selected content into Memova.

interface.shortDescription: Import selected content and run Memova workflows.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Memova through OAuth MCP for knowledge-base and automation workflows. Imports are limited to content the user explicitly selects in the current request, show a bounded preview, and locally remove detected passwords, API keys, tokens, and private keys before upload. The plugin does not enumerate Codex history or install background collection. Existing V2/V3 vault tools remain available only for compatibility.
defaultPrompt: Run my latest note automation tasks.
